- Primary customer stakeholders: Jamie Lee (Buyer), IT/Security (security@elara-sys.com), Procurement (procurements@elara-sys.com).

2) Intro call with Elara stakeholders to align roles and technical pre-reqs (30–45 min).
3) Confirm internal playbook owners (implementation, technical onboarding, success metrics).
